title: finding(core): ValueDataSource's object arm drops a Date comparand's constraint — { created: new Date(0) } answers as if the key were absent, while convertFiltersToAST lowers it to equality (objectui#8555 on the value face)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (b): one authored filter has two fates. Reader: triage first (route and grade).

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`). It comes from objectui#10817's dev report (`5858469332`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) and seat ruling `5858511329`, which routes that card's zero-key comparands through the converter. A `Date` lowers there without error, so it is left out of objectui#10817 and filed here. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measured

The dev's throwaway probe, on objectui `origin/main` `fb91ac9b0c`, not committed. The UI door was NOT measured.

`ValueDataSource.find` (a published `@object-ui/core` export) with an object `$filter`, over the rows `[{id:'1',status:'a',created:'x'},{id:'2',status:'a'},{id:'3',status:'b'}]`:
- `{ status: 'a', created: new Date(0) }` answers ids `1`, `2`, with 0 warnings. That is the same answer as `{ status: 'a' }`: the `created` constraint vanishes.
- `convertFiltersToAST` lowers the same filter to `['and', ['status','=','a'], ['created','=',Date]]`, an equality the wire applies.

## Why

`matchesFilter`'s operator arm treats any non-array object condition as an operator map. A `Date` has no own enumerable keys, so the operator loop runs zero times and the row passes. This is the objectui#8555 widening, which that card closed on the converter, now seen on the value face. `@objectstack/spec`'s `ACCEPTED_FILTER_COMPARAND_TYPES` includes `Date`.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

The object arm reads a `Date` condition as implicit equality, compared the same way the AST arm compares a `Date` comparand, so both arms and the wire give one answer. Pin it with `{ status: 'a', created: new Date(0) }` over rows that do and do not hold that instant; `{ status: 'a' }` is the control.

Serial: this card follows objectui#10817 (seat 2, in flight), which edits the same arm of `find` in `ValueDataSource.ts`.

## Dedupe

I listed the 900 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, and grepped them locally for `ValueDataSource` near `Date comparand | new Date | Date instance | date equality | Date value`. There were 0 hits. Lit control: `ValueDataSource` near `empty operator map` hits objectui#10817, objectui#10810 and objectui#10784.
